items.difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies that the tame symbol defined earlier satisfies the five structural properties announced for it: bilinearity, skew symmetry, and three normalization statements, the last of which is the one that forces the particular sign in its definition (statement lines 901-908, tag 0EAS). The verifications are computations rather than citations: for each identity one first prepares the symbol in a finite extension where the elements are monomials up to units, and then checks an identity among exponents and unit contributions, with the final property needing a genuine case distinction on the exponents together with the observation that the residue class of one unit is minus that of another. The case distinction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
